task.ques: Find a portable Bluetooth speaker on Amazon with a water-resistant design, under $50. It should have a minimum battery life of 10 hours.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Anker soundcore 2 Portable Bluetooth Speaker (Mocha Brown) — $33.98 on Amazon, with IPX7 waterproof protection and advertised 24-hour battery playtime. It meets the under-$50 price and minimum 10-hour battery requirements. Price excludes shipping and tax.
Source: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FRRMD96F (verified October 27, 2026).
Evidence: final.png shows the product name, selected color, price, waterproof protection, and battery claim together.
